camel_example: aliyun rds ModifyDBInstanceConfig --region cn-hangzhou --ConfigValue true --ConfigName pgbouncer --DBInstanceId 'pgm-2ze****'
description_en: Modifies the configurations of an ApsaraDB RDS instance
description_zh: 该接口用于修改RDS实例的配置项
kebab_example: aliyun rds modify-db-instance-config --db-instance-id 'pgm-2ze****' --config-name pgbouncer --config-value true --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifyDBInstanceConfig

parameters.help_en: Instance ID of the instance. You can call the DescribeDBInstances operation to query instance ID
parameters.name: db_instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The name of the configuration item to be modified. This parameter must be used together with the ConfigValue parameter.
<details>
<summary>Configuration items for ApsaraDB RDS for PostgreSQL</summary>

pgbouncer: modifies the PgBouncer feature.
encryptionKey: modifies the cloud disk encryption feature.
duckdb_create_databases: configures databases on the primary instance as DuckDB column store databases in batches.
duckdb_prepare_dependency: configures the primary instance with one click so that its parameters and minor engine version meet the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2977241.html for creating a DuckDB-based analytical instance. If read-only instances have been created for the primary instance, the read-only instances are also modified in synchronization.
enable_db_visible_by_connect_rls: enables CONNECT RLS to control database visibility for the instance.
set_db_visible_by_connect_rls: enables CONNECT RLS to control database visibility for databases. This parameter can be invoked only after CONNECT RLS is enabled for the instance.

</details>

<details>
<summary>Configuration items for ApsaraDB RDS for SQL Server</summary>

<props="intl">

clear_errorlog: clears error logs.
encryptionKey: modifies the cloud disk encryption feature. This feature is not supported for serverless instances and instances of the shared instance type.

</props>

<props="china">


backup_recovery_model: enables the simple recovery model. Only Basic Edition instances support this feature. This feature cannot be disabled after it is enabled.
clear_errorlog: clears error logs.
encryptionKey: modifies the cloud disk encryption feature. This feature is not supported for serverless instances and instances of the shared instance type.
</props>

</details>
parameters.help_zh:
待修改的配置项名称，配合ConfigValue使用。
<details>
<summary>RDS PostgreSQL配置项</summary>

pgbouncer：修改PgBouncer功能。
encryptionKey：修改云盘加密功能。
duckdb_create_databases: 批量配置主实例数据库为DuckDB列存库。
duckdb_prepare_dependency: 一键配置主实例使其参数、内核小版本满足创建DuckDB分析实例的https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2977241.html。如果主实例已创建了只读实例，会将只读实例同步修改。
enable_db_visible_by_connect_rls: 实例开启 CONNECT RLS 控制数据库可见性。
set_db_visible_by_connect_rls: 数据库开启 CONNECT RLS 控制数据库可见性，只有实例开启 CONNECT RLS 后才可调用。

</details>

<details>
<summary>RDS SQL Server配置项</summary>

<props="intl">

clear_errorlog：清理错误日志。
encryptionKey：修改云盘加密功能。Serverless实例和共享规格实例暂不支持开启该功能。

</props>

<props="china">


backup_recovery_model：开启简单恢复模式功能。仅基础系列实例支持开启，该功能开启后不支持关闭。
clear_errorlog：清理错误日志。
encryptionKey：修改云盘加密功能。Serverless实例和共享规格实例暂不支持开启该功能。
</props>

</details>
parameters.name: config_name

parameters.help_en:
The value of the configuration item to be modified. This parameter must be used together with the ConfigName parameter.

<details>
<summary>Values of configuration items for ApsaraDB RDS for PostgreSQL</summary>

PgBouncer feature: true (enable) or false (disable).
Cloud disk encryption feature:
ServiceKey: uses an automatically generated key from Alibaba Cloud, which is the RDS-managed service key (Default Service CMK), to enable cloud disk encryption.
<Key>: uses a custom key to enable cloud disk encryption or replace the current key. Example: `494c98ce-f2b5-48ab-96ab-36c986b6****`.
disabled: disables cloud disk encryption.
One-click repair of prerequisites for creating a DuckDB-based analytical instance: duckdb_prepare_dependency.
Batch configuration of databases on the primary instance as DuckDB column store databases. The value is a JSON string. Example: `{"dbNames": "db1,db2,db3", "accountName": "yourSuperAccountName"}`, where:
dbNames: the names of the databases to be converted to DuckDB column store databases. Separate multiple database names with commas (,).
accountName: the privileged account. You only need to configure one privileged account.
Enable CONNECT RLS to control database visibility for the instance: true (enable).
Enable CONNECT RLS to control database visibility for databases: the names of the databases managed by CONNECT RLS. Separate multiple database names with commas (,). Example: testdb1,testdb2. When a client connects to a database with CONNECT RLS enabled, the database list is correctly displayed based on whether the client has the CONNECT permission on other databases.
</details>
<details>
<summary>Values of configuration items for ApsaraDB RDS for SQL Server</summary>

<props="intl">

Error log cleanup feature: 1 (confirm cleanup).
Cloud disk encryption feature (this feature cannot be disabled after it is enabled):
serviceKey: uses an automatically generated key from Alibaba Cloud, which is the RDS-managed service key (Default Service CMK), to enable cloud disk encryption.
<Key>: uses a custom key to enable cloud disk encryption or replace the current key. Example: `494c98ce-f2b5-48ab-96ab-36c986b6****`.

</props>


<props="china">

Simple recovery feature: simple (enable simple recovery).
Error log cleanup feature: 1 (confirm cleanup).
Cloud disk encryption feature (this feature cannot be disabled after it is enabled):
serviceKey: uses an automatically generated key from Alibaba Cloud, which is the RDS-managed service key (Default Service CMK), to enable cloud disk encryption.
<Key>: uses a custom key to enable cloud disk encryption or replace the current key. Example: `494c98ce-f2b5-48ab-96ab-36c986b6****`.

</props>

</details>
parameters.help_zh:
待修改配置项的取值，配合ConfigName使用。

<details>
<summary>RDS PostgreSQL配置项取值</summary>

PgBouncer功能：true（开启）、false（关闭）。
云盘加密功能：
ServiceKey：使用由阿里云自动生成的密钥，即使用RDS托管的服务密钥（Default Service CMK）开启云盘加密。
<密钥>：使用自定义密钥开启云盘加密，或者更换当前密钥。例如`494c98ce-f2b5-48ab-96ab-36c986b6****`。
disabled：关闭云盘加密。
一键修复创建DuckDB分析实例所需的前提条件: duckdb_prepare_dependency
批量设置主实例数据库为DuckDB列存库，JSON字符串，例如`{"dbNames": "db1,db2,db3", "accountName": "yourSuperAccountName"}`，其中：
dbNames：要转为DuckDB列存库的数据库名称。多个数据库之间使用英文逗号（,）分隔。
accountName：高权限账号。只需配置一个高权限账号。
实例开启 CONNECT RLS 控制数据库可见性：true 开启。
数据库开启 CONNECT RLS 控制数据库可见性：受 CONNECT RLS 管控数据库名称。多个数据库之间使用英文逗号（,）分隔。如 testdb1,testdb2。客户连接开启 CONNECT RLS 的数据库会根据是否对其他数据库有 CONNECT 权限而正确展示数据库列表。
</details>
<details>
<summary>RDS SQL Server配置项取值</summary>

<props="intl">

错误日志清理功能：1（确认清理）。
云盘加密功能（该功能开启后无法关闭）：
serviceKey：使用由阿里云自动生成的密钥，即使用RDS托管的服务密钥（Default Service CMK）开启云盘加密。
<密钥>：使用自定义密钥开启云盘加密，或者更换当前密钥。例如`494c98ce-f2b5-48ab-96ab-36c986b6****`。

</props>


<props="china">

简单恢复功能：simple（开启简单恢复）。
错误日志清理功能：1（确认清理）。
云盘加密功能（该功能开启后无法关闭）：
serviceKey：使用由阿里云自动生成的密钥，即使用RDS托管的服务密钥（Default Service CMK）开启云盘加密。
<密钥>：使用自定义密钥开启云盘加密，或者更换当前密钥。例如`494c98ce-f2b5-48ab-96ab-36c986b6****`。

</props>

</details>

parameters.help_en: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request and prevent duplicate submissions. You can use the client to generate the token, but you must ensure that it is unique among different requests. The token can contain a maximum of 64 ASCII characters and cannot contain non-ASCII characters
parameters.help_zh: 用于保证请求的幂等性，防止重复提交请求。由客户端生成该参数值，要保证在不同请求间唯一，最大值不超过64个ASCII字符，且该参数值中不能包含非ASCII字符
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en: The time when the modification is executed. Perform the modification during off-peak hours. Specify the time in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC
parameters.help_zh: 指定执行修改的时间。建议在业务低峰期执行变配。格式：yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ（UTC时间）

parameters.help_en:
The time when the modification takes effect. Valid values:
Immediate: takes effect immediately.
MaintainTime: takes effect within the maintenance window. You can call the ModifyDBInstanceMaintainTime operation to modify the maintenance window

切换时间。取值：
Immediate：立即生效。
MaintainTime：在可运维时间段内生效，可调用ModifyDBInstanceMaintainTime接口修改可运维时间段
